The app builds successfully. Here's what was created:

**ShipmentTracker** — a Blazor Web App (.NET 11) with **Auto render mode** (Interactive Server → WebAssembly handoff):

### Architecture Choices
| Requirement | Solution |
|---|---|
| Fast first load | Server-side prerendering via Interactive Server |
| Snappy after load | WebAssembly takes over (no server round-trips) |
| Worldwide latency | Auto mode — WASM runs locally after download |
| Interactive controls | Every page uses `@rendermode InteractiveAuto` |
| Individual auth | ASP.NET Identity with cookie auth (login, register, manage) |

### Key Pages
- **`/dispatch`** — Dispatcher dashboard: table of all shipments, filter by destination/status, inline status update dropdown
- **`/track`** — Customer tracking: enter tracking number, see progress bar + delivery ETA
- **`/my-shipments`** — Customer view: look up shipments by email, card layout with status badges

### Project Structure
- **Server project** — EF Core + SQLite, API endpoints (`/api/shipments`), `ServerShipmentService` for SSR
- **Client project** — `ClientShipmentService` calls API via `HttpClient` when running in WebAssembly
- Shared `IShipmentService` interface + `ShipmentDto` model in the Client assembly
- Database seeded with 6 sample international shipments

Run with: `cd ShipmentTracker/ShipmentTracker && dotnet run`
